description: Reviewed registry of research sources the coordinator may download from, in addition to the built-in floor in discovery.py. Add a source with `campaign.py register-source` (research-home overlay) or, when it should be permanent, by a reviewed edit here. https only; never IP literals, cloud or Firebase hosts.

sources.license: US Government public domain (USACE CWMS Data API)
sources.purpose: reservoir pool elevation / water temperature time series by USACE district
sources.rationale: Lake Brain's own level provider (usace-cwms-pool); alternate level source for lakes without USGS series
dataset discovery for the Fish/Depth/Vegetation evidence gaps

sources.license: per record (open licences only are downloaded)
sources.purpose: published research datasets and supplementary files
sources.rationale: dataset discovery and small open-licence downloads

sources.purpose: USGS/state fisheries, bathymetry and habitat data releases
sources.rationale: federal dataset discovery for Fish, Depth and Vegetation

sources.license: USGS/UMRR LTRM data, no licence stated (public release; credit the UMRR LTRM element and cite; disclaimer in the data format file)
sources.purpose: Upper Mississippi River LTRM fisheries database: dated catches with water temperature, gear (day/night electrofishing), stratum and depth
sources.rationale: only broad multi-species open catch dataset with temperature and day/night gear found by the open-web search; validates Fish night-activity and cold-water rules (river-system surrogate for reservoirs)

sources.license: Public domain (Iowa Environmental Mesonet disclaimer: free for any lawful purpose)
sources.purpose: hourly airport (ASOS/AWOS) wind observations for nighttime calm-wind climatology and forecast verification near reservoirs
sources.rationale: verified working request API (open-web search 2026-10-25); the only free multi-decade hourly wind archive near US reservoirs

sources.license: US Government (USACE eHydro survey data; copyright text 'USACE', no restrictive licence stated)
sources.purpose: dated hydrographic survey footprints and survey packages (XYZ/TIN with metadata incl. vertical datum) for reservoirs
sources.rationale: verified by open-web search 2026-10-25 and by a live query: public ArcGIS feature service, no login; only source of dated reservoir surveys with datum metadata for Depth (DEPTH-DAT-001)

sources.license: US Government (USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species database; cite and agree to terms)
sources.purpose: dated georeferenced OBSERVED records of invasive submerged plants (confirmed presence, not habitat potential)
sources.rationale: verified by a live query 2026-10-25; observed-vegetation truth source for Vegetation (VEG-VAL-001); presence only, effort-uneven
